figures.caption: Figure 1: Conceptual illustration of the evaluation landscape for conversational recommender systems. The horizontal axis denotes performance on proxy metrics (e.g., BLEU, Recall), while the vertical axis represents user-aligned recommendation quality (e.g., satisfaction and relevance). Existing systems often achieve high proxy scores with limited alignment to user preferences. Positions are illustrative rather than measured values.
Table 5: Virtual Tool Operations taxonomy. These 21 domain-agnostic primitives abstract implementation details, enabling cross-domain transfer of learned reasoning patterns.

Table 4: Ablation study on ReDial. Component ablations retrain without the specified module; “w/o VTOs” sets λv=0 in Eq. 13. Mechanism variants modify inference only. Component contributions are non-additive due to interactions. Sat./Eng. ∈ [0, 1]; all metrics in %.

Table 3: Main recommendation results on three datasets. R@K: Recall@K (%). Values: mean±std over 3 runs with different random seeds. User Sat./Engage.: normalized [0,1]. Avg.: macro-average of normalized metrics. †Text-only adaptation using item descriptions. ‡Fine-tuned following the protocol in Wang et al. (2025). Bold: best; ∆: relative improvement (%) over strongest baseline. All HARPO improvements are statistically significant at p < 0.01 (paired t-test with Bonferroni correction).

Figure 2: Overall architecture of the HARPO framework. The model integrates four components: STAR for structured agentic reasoning, CHARM for hierarchical preference optimization, BRIDGE for cross-domain transfer, and MAVEN for multi-agent refinement, all built on a shared language model backbone.

Table 8: Human evaluation (1-5 scale). Rec.Q: Recommendation Quality, Exp.Q: Explanation Quality. κ: Fleiss’ kappa inter-annotator agreement. All HARPO improvements significant at p < 0.01 (Mann-Whitney U).
Table 10: Hyperparameter sensitivity on ReDial. Default values achieve near-optimal performance; increasing beam width/depth beyond defaults provides diminishing returns.
Table 7: Generation quality and VTO accuracy. Bn: BLEU-n, R-L: ROUGE-L, D-n: Distinct-n, VTOP/R/F1: VTO Precision/Recall/F1.
